verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents real-time webhooks and a web app view of delivery status (success, queued, failed). It also lets you re-deliver events after downtime, which covers event logs and replay. Stable event IDs for handling retries imply automatic redelivery, but the evidence never mentions signed payloads or signature verification. Missing for 10: documented webhook signing/signature verification, an explicit automatic retry schedule/policy, programmatic (API) replay or log access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
